line-producer.notes: Bookkeeping, status wording, and the Director's question rounds. Cheap model. Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the environment. D6 calls this the admin model.

director.notes: Drafting uses Claude Sonnet 5.5. The final treatment pass uses Claude Opus 5.5. Question bookkeeping stays on the line producer model. Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

screenwriter.notes: Skill file only. No program selects a generator yet. D6: writing uses Claude Sonnet or Opus when this role gets a program.

art-director.notes: Skill file only. No program selects a generator yet.

cinematographer.notes: Camera package and storyboard prompts. Writing model, per D6. Image generation is not called from this role. The offline path is used when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset. Board prompts stay offline even when a key is set, so a model cannot drop a locked phrase.

script-supervisor.notes: Continuity check. Cheap model. The findings are computed in code. The model may only reword the summary. Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

prop-master.notes: Locks the props the production already defined. Cheap model. A model reply that changes a prop is discarded. Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

stunt-coordinator.notes: Turns treatment action beats into a shot breakdown. Writing model, per D6. The beat text has to stay the production's. Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

production.notes: The production program calls Seedance 2.0 on fal.ai today. D6: final video is planned on Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, with cheap previews. Seedance and Kling stay Director-routed alternates. This file still records the program that runs today.

sound-designer.notes: Dialogue and sound effects pass these model ids. Score uses the ElevenLabs music compose call, which takes no model id.

qa.notes: The QA program calls this Claude model today. D6: dailies and QA move to Gemini because it can watch picture and hear sound together. The program has not switched yet.
